_comment: Models the assistant can download. Provisional until the phase 6 evaluation (docs/design-assistant.md). Sizes and SHA-256 come from the publisher's Hugging Face file listing, read 2026-11-10; VCSIDE checks the hash after every download.

models.name: Qwen3 4B
models.note: Any laptop with 8 GB of memory. Plain chat with the knowledge base; the agent may be unreliable.

models.name: Qwen3 8B
models.note: Recommended for 16 GB machines. The smallest size meant for the agent.

models.name: Qwen3 14B
models.note: For 24 GB machines or a GPU with 12 GB or more. Better at multi-step edits.
